Definition: Nobach, the name of an Israelite, and of a place East of the Jordan
BiblicalUsage: Nobah is a man who names a town after himself. He takes Kenath and its villages and calls it Nobah, after his own name, and Gideon passes east of Nobah when he pursues the Midianite kings.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that naming a town after yourself is the oldest vanity: Nobah took Kenath and wrote his own name on it.
